casual.EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere
casual.POSE: Stand at ease with relaxed shoulders and naturally balanced feet.
casual.ORIENTATION: torso and pelvis face the camera; gaze is independent
casual.SCENE: In a private snowy mountain hotel suite at soft dawn, standing comfortably at an open cedar wardrobe, loosely spreading a burgundy silk scarf between two separated hands at waist height while deciding how to style it. Frosted window light, folded blankets, no mirror or other figures.
casual.OUTFIT: Opaque fully lined mauve satin slip dress with broad secure shoulder straps, lace-trimmed covered neckline and below-knee flowing hem, small ruby earrings. Bare arms shoulders and upper chest, all intimate areas fully covered; no metal headband or armor.
casual.CATEGORY: Use tasteful adult lingerie-inspired evening fashion with full intimate coverage. Describe the garment by its construction — cut, fabric, trim, straps, closures, layers — rather than by mood words. The garments are securely fitted and fully opaque, and the look is suitable for a mainstream evening-fashion editorial. Build the image through framing, silhouette, posture, and lighting rather than exposure.
casual.FRAMING: Waist-up framing showing the head, torso and relevant hand gesture; place essential props inside this crop.
casual.LENS: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.

casual.EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes fixed on one point, mouth firmly closed
casual.POSE: Sit naturally on a chair or bench with supported feet and readable hands.
casual.ORIENTATION: side body profile, approximately 90 degrees to camera
casual.SCENE: In an empty vintage conservatory music room at warm late afternoon, sitting upright side-on at a grand piano, playing a simple quiet phrase with both hands separated across the keyboard. Face turned slightly toward viewer, knees and both complete wrists visible; snowy trees beyond glass, no sheet music lettering or other figures.
casual.OUTFIT: Opaque crimson sleeveless mock-neck knit top, plum high-waisted A-line midi skirt with a single side slit below the thigh and ivory low heels. Bare arms and a little leg, small snow-crystal pendant; ordinary winter indoor clothing without armor.
casual.CATEGORY: Show a personal hobby or restful leisure moment with a specific action and relevant objects. Pokémon motifs may appear naturally in the activity, without requiring armor, a uniform or a companion.
casual.FRAMING: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
casual.LENS: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.

casual.EXPRESSION: chin lifted, brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth
casual.POSE: Raise one hand near shoulder height in a friendly small wave.
casual.ORIENTATION: front three-quarter body turn of about 30-45 degrees; rotate torso and pelvis together
casual.SCENE: On an empty snowy cable-car observation platform at clear winter noon, giving a small relaxed open-hand wave beside her shoulder while the other empty hand rests naturally on a broad wooden railing. Full head and winter boots visible, distant red cable car and mountains, no signs or other people.

casual.CATEGORY: Show travel or peaceful field exploration in the Pokémon world, with useful travel clothing and a specific activity. Let the environment support the woman without overwhelming her or turning the scene into combat.
casual.FRAMING: Full-body framing: keep the complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins.
casual.LENS: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
